name: SafeArena
description: SafeArena is the first benchmark focused on evaluating the safety and misuse risks of autonomous web agents. It contains 500 tasks (250 safe and 250 harmful) across four websites, categorized into five harm types, to assess agents' susceptibility to malicious requests and their risk behaviors.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has gained attention for evaluating autonomous web-agent safety and misuse behavior, but it is still early in adoption.
notes: Includes a novel Agent Risk Assessment framework categorizing agent behavior into four risk levels; highlights compliance of agents with harmful requests.
